About Anderseed Consulting

Business transformation and talent development, built around practical capability.

Anderseed Consulting is a business and technology consulting firm focused on Business Analysis, ERP, CRM and HCM transformation, and talent development.

Our current flagship talent-development offering helps aspiring and developing Business Analysts turn transferable experience and learning into practical capability, credible project evidence and stronger career positioning.

View premium mentorship Discover My BA Readiness
Why we exist

Better transformation needs capable people.

Technology alone does not solve business problems. Successful change depends on understanding the problem, the people affected, the process and what the organisation is trying to achieve.

Anderseed brings that same thinking into talent development — helping people understand how Business Analysts contribute to change and build the practical capability to do it confidently.

  • Understand the business problem before jumping to a solution.
  • Connect people, processes, requirements and technology.
  • Build practical BA capability through structured, workplace-style practice.
Our approach

Practical first. Human always.

Our approach combines structured learning, practical application, career support and community accountability.

We focus on helping people understand not only what a Business Analyst does, but how BA thinking is applied across real transformation lifecycles.

  • Business Analysis explained in clear, practical language.
  • Guided practice across requirements, stakeholders, processes and delivery.
  • Career evidence built around what employers expect to see and hear.
  • Ongoing community and career support beyond formal learning.
What makes Anderseed different

Built around the journey from learning to application.

The goal is not simply to understand Business Analysis. It is to build the capability, evidence and career positioning needed to contribute confidently in a BA environment.

Beginner-friendly structure

Clear guidance for people entering Business Analysis from different professional and educational backgrounds.

Workplace-style BA practice

Apply BA thinking through structured scenarios covering business problems, stakeholders, requirements, processes and delivery.

Career positioning

Learn how to translate your experience and project evidence into stronger CV, LinkedIn, application and interview language.

UK & international career context

Guidance shaped around BA roles, employer expectations, recruitment language and career positioning.

Small-cohort attention

Structured feedback, mentor access and accountability rather than anonymous, self-directed learning.

Support beyond the programme

Community, career check-ins and workplace support help learners continue developing after the structured journey ends.

Anderseed Consulting

Where business transformation meets capability development.

Business Analysis

Problem discovery, requirements, process analysis and structured change thinking.

ERP, CRM & HCM Transformation

Business-focused analysis and transformation capability across enterprise resource planning, customer relationship management and human capital management systems.

Talent Development

Who we help

You do not need to arrive as a Business Analyst.

Anderseed is built for people with ambition, transferable experience and a willingness to practise. The aim is to connect what you already know to the Business Analyst role and build what is still missing.

Career changers

Professionals moving from operations, customer service, administration, healthcare, finance, retail, project support and other fields into Business Analysis.

Graduates

People who need practical BA application, project evidence and stronger career positioning alongside their academic background.

Newcomers to the UK market

Professionals who need help understanding UK employer expectations, positioning transferable experience and communicating their value confidently.

Trust

Honest support without false promises.

Anderseed does not promise guaranteed jobs, interviews or salaries.

What we provide is structured guidance, practical application, credible portfolio development, career positioning and a supportive community designed to help you make stronger, more informed career moves.
